reason: The dense knot and nearby cold cloud seem like a direct way to investigate whether the surviving clumps can form stars.
expectation: I expect the cold gas to gather with the knot, possibly leading to new stars, though it may need another step.

alternatives.reason: The young stars may illuminate or alter the dust, but I want to follow the surviving clumps first.

effect: The surviving clumps formed young stars, completing that goal; I can now follow the dust.
reaction: It is satisfying to see material from the old pillars become new stars.
reason: The chapter points to dust traveling with the nursery outflow, so I will explore that path.
expectation: I expect the outflow to carry some dust away from the nursery, though its eventual fate is uncertain.

alternatives.reason: The young stars may affect dust that remains near them, but I want to follow the outflow first.

effect: The outflow carries dust away, with some grains sheltered and others exposed; I can follow it into the hot outer gas.
reaction: The distinction between sheltered and exposed grains makes their fate intriguing.
reason: Following the carried dust into the outer gas should clarify what happens to it.
expectation: I expect the hot outer gas to alter or disperse the dust, though I am unsure whether the grains survive.

alternatives.reason: The stars could reveal the other dust path, but I want to finish following the outflow first.

effect: The hot outer gas erodes many dust grains, returning their material to the gas; the remaining offered combination can explore dust near the stars.
reaction: The contrast between sheltered grains and those destroyed by hot gas is interesting.
reason: This is the only offered combination and follows the other dust path described in the chapter.
expectation: I expect the young stars to warm or illuminate the nearby dust, though I don't know its eventual fate.

effect: The remaining dust absorbs starlight and radiates in infrared, completing the inherited-dust goal and the chapter.
reaction: The distinction between glowing gas and warmed dust was a useful closing detail.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following the surviving pillar clumps into new stars tied their earlier history to a satisfying outcome.

leastWorthwhile.text: Carrying dust outward was a fairly predictable intermediate step, though it set up its later fate.

surprise.text: Many outward-bound dust grains are gradually eroded by fast particles in the hot outer gas, returning their material to the gas.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless; the offered combinations followed the stated goals, though their compatibility was supplied by the menu.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to follow how the dispersed material changes later, especially after seeing the dust and clumps take different paths.
